events.reason: Stratega opens the central district B first; everything else orbits it.
Stola takes the nearest door, district A, two steps east.
Hasta claims the barracks-side district C; the east column is his road.
Vela steps into district E, one pace from her own gate.
Stratega sweeps west for the pugio at A before the long column south.
Stola shuffles one step east and lifts the galea from B.
Hasta drops south to F; he will rake the whole row westward.
Vela drifts east to F, already eyeing the barracks road north.
Stratega takes the last blind district D straight south; no stone unsearched.
Stola takes the near step to C for the gladius.
Hasta rakes westward to E, one step, exactly on plan.
Vela shrugs and tries the eastern guard post while her feet are stuck.
Stratega collects the scutum at E, three pieces from the checkpoint.
Stola takes the short drop south to F for the lorica.
Hasta picks up the pilum at D one step west; hoard first, spend never.
Vela grumbles at the die and walks back west toward the unopened cellars road.
Stratega lifts the lorica at F; one district left before the checkpoint.
Stola slides one step west for the scutum at E; nearest first, always.
Hasta banks a free throw at the western post; Glory is Emperor money.
Vela cannot resist another toss of the die at the eastern post.
Stratega takes the gladius at C; six of six, the checkpoint waits one turn.
Stola steps next door for the pilum at D and completes her kit.
Hasta tries the northwest post again; every token is a sharper pilum for the Emperor.
Vela strolls back toward the middle with her purse already full.
Stratega plants her standard on the checkpoint: the countdown to the Emperor starts.
Stola taps the closest post right beside her before the doors close.
Hasta grabs the pugio at A while he waits out the countdown.
Vela idles toward the west wing; her purse is full and the doors are closing.
Stratega banks one more token at the northwest post before the descent.
Stola rolls the die at the near post again, a coin for the cellar dark.
Hasta presses for a second token; two coins buy two brutal swings at the throne.
Vela wanders to the western wall and waits for the floor to change.
Stratega returns to the checkpoint square with a full purse, marking time.
Stola drifts down the west walk, purse full, counting heartbeats.
Hasta takes one last step east, one coin short and already hungry for the throne.
Vela kicks a pebble south; the last dead turn before the palace turns over.
Stratega flashes a Glory token at the peristyle and walks out with the first seal, no dice needed.
Stola takes the nearest open door, the cellars, and trusts the dark.
Hasta marches on the guard barracks; his coin stays sewn in his belt.
Vela grins and challenges the barracks guard the long way around the court.
Stratega drops into the cellars for her second seal, the safer ladder down.
Stola creeps one step east, cursing the short die, peristyle next door.
Hasta crosses to the cellars for the surer door; his single coin stays hidden.
Vela tries the wine-dark cellars; a gamble is a gamble, even a mild one.
Stratega steps onto the central column; a short die will not stop the march south.
Stola pays the peristyle price; nearest door, bought and bolted.
Hasta rattles the cellar door again; no coin leaves his belt.
Vela slides to the antechamber door, one step from the purple room.
Stratega stakes a Glory token on the first blow; half the throne room holds its breath.
Stola throws her last coin at the Emperor while the door is still open.
Hasta knocks on the cellar door a third time, jaw set.
Vela bets a coin on her first cut at the Emperor, grinning through the odds.
Stratega strikes again with a bare blade, no coin left to sweeten it.
Stola hacks at the Emperor beside her rivals, closest blade first as always.
Hasta finally unsews the coin from his belt and puts everything into one cut.
Vela stakes her last coin on the killing blow, laughing at the guard above.
